title: Cattaneo, Jansson and Nagasawa, "Bootstrap-Based Inference for Cube Root Asymptotics" (Econometrica 88(5), 2020): simulation tuning constants
paper: Matias D. Cattaneo, Michael Jansson and Kenichi Nagasawa, Bootstrap-Based Inference for Cube Root Asymptotics, Econometrica 88(5): 2203-2219, 2020, doi 10.3982/ECTA17950
cost_basis: typical on-demand price for a 4 vCPU, 16 GB cloud machine
scope_notes: Only the three scripts that produce the tuning constants used by the simulations were run: `DGP_constants.R` (the true H0), `AMSE.R` (AMSE-optimal tuning parameters) and `mse_opt_simulation.R` (MSE-optimal tuning parameters from 50,000 Monte Carlo draws per model). Each writes a committed text file, which is what was compared.

Not run: `main_maxscore.R`, the bootstrap simulation behind the paper's table (`table_maxscore.txt`). The README says it was run in batch mode, and its settings (2,000 bootstrap draws for each of 2,000 simulations, over a parallel cluster) are beyond this machine. Nothing here speaks to that table.
`V0.txt` is committed but no script in the package writes it; it is not compared.
